newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Illinois offers up on exports.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Illinois offers up on exports.

text.p: Some soymeal basis rail offers in Illinois were higher Monday in response to spot demand for soymeal in the export market, brokers said.
"I heard there was a little bit of export business going on, and that's why we're up," one Southeastern broker said.
However, some dealers reported little interest in soymeal at the higher values.
Most activity on Monday was described as quiet.
CBOT prices are still higher and said to be discouraging anything but spot purches of soymeal, dealers and brokers said.
The Ohio River was slowly sinking back below flood stage so the pace of barge traffic was picking up, dealers there said.
"It's (the river) dropped pretty dramatically over the weekend," said one Kentucky dealer. "We're supposed to be below flood stage in the next day or two."
